model_annotation: The image presents three separate pie charts side-by-side illustrating proportional breakdowns for three distinct overarching topics: "Categorical," "Approximate Number Generation," and "Disjunctive &Conjunctive." None of the charts feature a separate external legend or any exploded or offset slices for visual emphasis; instead, bolded text labels and precise percentages are placed directly inside each respective slice. The leftmost chart, titled "Categorical," contains four slices without a strict size-based order: a light pink segment labeled "Limiter" (27.91%), a pale blue-grey segment labeled "Universal Quantifiers" (29.07%), a light orange segment corresponding to "Negation" (27.91%), and a light green segment whose label and percentage are heavily obscured by a rectangular blur but partially show the words "Existential Quantifiers" covering the remaining proportion. The middle chart, titled "Approximate Number Generation," comprises three slices that appear ordered in descending size clockwise starting from the right hemisphere: a light beige segment designated "Approximate Quantities" (45.03%), a light blue segment for "Comparative Relationships" (36.26%), and a light purple segment marked "Absolute Absence" (18.71%). The rightmost chart, titled "Disjunctive &Conjunctive," is divided into two nearly equal halves, containing a pale pink slice on the right labeled "Conjunctive" (50.49%) and a very pale blue-grey slice on the left representing "Disjunctive" (49.51%).
